description: Demolition of existing garage and alterations to parking with construction of single storey attached side annexe with habitable rooms in loft, balconies and roof extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed development by virtue of its size, form, siting and bulk would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant and out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD5, DMD6, DMD8, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by reason of its location and proximity to the existing residential dwellings would give rise to an unacceptable loss of light, outlook, and a heightened sense of enclosure detrimental to the occupiers of the adjoining property at No. 7 and No. 8 Orchardmede contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8, DMD10 and DMD14 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by reason of its design would fail to provide private amenity space required, relying instead on a shared rear garden with the existing dwelling. As a result, the development would fail to provide a satisfactory standard of amenity for future occupiers and is therefore contrary to Policy DMD9 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development would result in additional residential accommodation within the Zone of Influence of the Epping Forest Special Area of Conservation (SAC) and would therefore be likely to increase recreational pressure on the SAC. In the absence of a financial contribution towards the Epping Forest Strategic Access Management and Monitoring Measures (SAMM) and Suitable Alternative Natural Greenspace (SANGS), the Local Planning Authority cannot conclude that the proposal would not have an adverse effect on the integrity of the SAC, either alone or in combination with other plans and projects. The proposal therefore fails to comply with the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 (as amended), the Habitats Directive (92/43/EEC), Policy HE1 and HE5 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2026, Policy G7 of the London Plan, and relevant policies of the Development Plan.
